chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ismail ibn Hammam, from Ali ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about the man who kisses the front private part of the wife. He said, 'There is no problem'.

key_terms.أَبَا الْحَسَنِ: Abu Al-Hasan, a title for Imam Musa al-Kazim (peace be upon him), the sixth Imam.
key_terms.قُبُلَ: The front or anterior part of the body, specifically referring to the female private part in this context.
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: There is no problem; a legal phrase indicating permissibility or lack of objection.

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a husband to kiss his wife's front private part according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi’s chapter on miscellaneous rulings, this hadith from Imam al-Rida (AS) clarifies the permissibility of oral intimacy between spouses, reflecting the Shia juristic view that acts are permissible unless explicitly prohibited. This ruling underscores the principle of 'al-asl fi al-shay' al-ibaha' (the default state of things is permissibility), providing a nuanced legal basis for marital affection beyond mere procreation.
